One early member I particularly remember was Harry Hare, a walker. He started a fund for half-bricks as a building fund with the object of buying our own hall.

• Harry Hare's daughter sent a donation for £100 to commemorate the 100th year since her father's birth on 9th May 1895. Harry was the founder of our Club magazine The Belgravian, its first Editor and the Club was a very great part of his life.
